patterns.note: The site uses a classic blog layout featuring a two-column main content area for article listings and a single-column sidebar for navigation and supplementary content.
A single sans-serif font family is used throughout the site, with hierarchy established purely through variations in font size, weight, and color (e.g., lighter gray for metadata).
The color palette is extremely minimal, relying on high contrast between dark text and white backgrounds, with a single dark blue for header/footer and a standard blue for interactive elements.
No scroll-triggered motion is present; all elements are static and scroll with the page without animation or sticky behavior.
Blog post listings are presented as consistent cards, each featuring a title, category, date, excerpt, and a 'read more' button, arranged in a uniform two-column grid.

technique_notes: The page structure is built around a main content area and a sidebar, likely using a responsive grid system to adapt the two-column article layout and single-column sidebar across different screen sizes.
Typography establishes hierarchy by varying font size and weight within a single sans-serif typeface, using darker, bolder text for headings and lighter, smaller text for metadata.
Interactive elements like buttons use a solid background color with contrasting white text to clearly indicate calls to action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are moderately larger and bolder than body text, with smaller, lighter text for metadata and labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp; all corners are essentially 0px, contributing to a very crisp and functional aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; content blocks are clearly separated with consistent vertical margins, and text lines are comfortably spaced for readability.

standout: The site's design is remarkably straightforward and functional, eschewing modern design trends like elaborate animations or complex visual hierarchies. Its distinction lies in its pure, content-first approach, presenting information in a clean, unadorned blog format reminiscent of earlier web aesthetics.
